Guidance: Unique identifier for the assumption or constraint entry.
Specify whether this entry is an 'Assumption' or a 'Constraint'.
The category of the assumption or constraint (e.g., Technical, Financial, Schedule, Resource).
A clear, detailed description of the assumption or constraint.
The potential risk or impact to the project if the assumption proves false or the constraint is breached.
The person or role tasked with following up on the assumption to validate its accuracy.
The target date by which the assumption needs to be validated or reviewed.
Specific actions required to validate the assumption or monitor the constraint.
The current status of the assumption (e.g., active, validated, closed).
Any additional information, operational context, or status updates.
